facts.fact: The Western Cape Government states that its Social Work Integrated Management System (SWIMS) went live in April 2024 and was used by 1,054 provincial Department of Social Development practitioners, who capture case management forms for clients on it, with 2,157 cases opened in June 2024.

systems.owner: Western Cape Department of Social Development and Department of the Premier

ZAF.note: SWIMS is a provincial social-work case management app; the source states no beneficiary payments or other programmes.

facts.fact: The Western Cape Government says its Department of the Premier's Centre for e-Innovation created the Social Work Integrated Management System for the Department of Social Development.

The Western Cape Government says SWIMS, created by its Department of the Premier's Centre for e-Innovation with the Department of Social Development, went live in April 2024 and is used by 1,054 practitioners, at a cost of R6 million.

systems.owner: Western Cape Department of Social Development

ZAF.note: Provincial government in the Western Cape; who runs and maintains SWIMS after launch is not stated.
